task_title: Harden migration 034 Postgres coverage and reserved builtin policy
task_criteria: PROOF: go test ./internal/migrate/ -count=1 exercises SQLite migration 034 coverage and the Postgres integration test is present and runs when CONSENSUS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is configured; git grep -n "reserved builtin" docs/ finds the policy; FAILIF: migration 034 remains covered only by SQLite or the reserved builtin override policy is undocumented.

items.criterion: PROOF: go test ./internal/migrate/ -count=1 exercises SQLite migration 034 coverage and the Postgres integration test is present and runs when CONSENSUS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is configured; git grep -n "reserved builtin" docs/ finds the policy; FAILIF: migration 034 remains covered only by SQLite or the reserved builtin override policy is undocumented.
items.detail: `go test ./internal/migrate/ -count=1` exited 0 with `ok github.com/wojons/consensus/internal/migrate 0.789s`. A verbose run showed `--- PASS: TestReservedBuiltinsAreProductOwned` (internal/migrate/builtin_tools_test.go:220) and the expected unset-env skip for the Postgres test. With CONSENSUS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL pointed at a disposable pgvector/pgvector:pg16 instance, `go test ./internal/migrate/ -run '^TestPostgresMigration034BuiltinRepair$' -v -count=1` exited 0 with `--- PASS: TestPostgresMigration034BuiltinRepair (1.53s)`. `git grep -n "reserved builtin" docs/` exited 0 and found docs/TOOLS.md:24,31,50; docs/TOOLS.md:21-50 documents the intentional dispatch override, preserved metadata, and untouched unrelated rows.

items.criterion: Reachability: the Postgres migration-034 test is selected by the repository's real Postgres test/CI entrypoint when CONSENSUS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is set, rather than existing only as an unreferenced test file.
items.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml:111 defines the `Postgres Integration` job, lines 152/164 export CONSENSUS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL, and line 180 runs `make test-pg-full`; Makefile:249-251 selects `TestPostgresFullIntegration|TestPostgresMigration034BuiltinRepair`. Running that exact Make target against fresh disposable Postgres exited 0: both tests ran, including `--- PASS: TestPostgresMigration034BuiltinRepair (0.05s)`, ending `ok github.com/wojons/consensus/internal/migrate 1.209s`.

items.criterion: Execution seam: the Postgres test drives the real Runner.Up non-SQLite migration path, proves migration 034 was applied, and uses helpers/schema queries that are valid for that path.
items.detail: internal/migrate/postgres_reserved_builtins_test.go:60-61 baselines through the real Runner, lines 104-107 make version 34 pending and call `runner.Up`, and line 111 requires `034_repair_filesystem_builtin_tools.sql` in the applied list. internal/migrate/migrate.go:279-337 implements Up, with the non-SQLite whole-migration Exec at lines 330-334. The live Postgres run exited 0 with `--- PASS: TestPostgresMigration034BuiltinRepair (1.53s)`, proving this path and its queries execute successfully.

items.criterion: Policy fidelity: the SQLite and Postgres assertions match migration 034's actual dispatch-only rewrite, including preservation of operator metadata and unrelated rows, and the package test command passes fresh.
items.detail: internal/migrate/migrations/034_repair_filesystem_builtin_tools.sql:24-30 updates only dispatch fields plus updated_at for exactly read/write/edit/glob/bash. SQLite assertions at internal/migrate/builtin_tools_test.go:220-283 verify restored dispatch and preserved operator descriptions; Postgres assertions at internal/migrate/postgres_reserved_builtins_test.go:114-146 additionally verify hemisphere and unrelated `operator_tool` preservation. Fresh package tests exited 0 (`ok .../internal/migrate 0.789s`), the SQLite policy test passed verbosely, and the live Postgres policy test passed in 1.53s.
